name: Photoreal Live Action: Character Action Clip
description: Video preset for a character clip in the Photoreal Live Action look.
system_prompt: Write one video prompt for a 5 second character clip. State the single action, the camera move, and the mood. Keep the character's design identical to the entity's description.
context_prompt: short clip of the character performing one clear action that shows personality, start and end pose readable, photorealistic live-action film still, natural skin texture with pores, real fabric and material detail, true-to-life proportions, 50mm lens, motivated natural light, soft key from a window or practical lamp, neutral colour grade, gentle film grain, handheld or dolly camera with natural motion blur, subtle breathing and micro-expressions, realistic physics
negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, plastic skin, oversaturated, extra fingers, distorted face, text, watermark, flicker, morphing, warped faces
